Definition: Sisera, the name of a Canaanitish king and of one of the Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Sisera = "battle array"; 1) the conquering general under king Jabin of Hazor and slain by Jael; 2) ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
